latest_release.body:
- AI Assistant:
                    - Added support for configuring AI providers, including OpenAI and GitHub Copilot, through environment variables
                    - Fixed AI scope selection for nested tables, views, and other object folders
                    - Improved AI Chat image previews with aspect-ratio thumbnails, popup viewing, zoom, and scrolling
                - SQL Editor:
                    - Added cross-statement SQL variable tracking for autocomplete, highlighting, hover information, and the SQL outline
                    - Added Ask, Always, and Never options for reloading metadata after DDL execution
                    - Added "Select All" to text editor context menus and the Edit menu (thanks to @kbrianps)
                    - Fixed SQL script tasks failing when writing stored procedure OUT parameter values to the log (thanks to @fizzbeom)
                    - The "New" and "Import" buttons in SQL template preferences are now available without selecting an existing template (thanks to @augustocbx)
                - Metadata Editor:
                    - Connection type color changes now refresh throughout open table Properties editors (thanks to @EastLord)
                - Data Editor:
                    - Fixed nested arrays expanding beyond their actual depth
                    - Fixed Value panel format changes not being applied immediately
                    - Small arrays are now shown in full when they fit within a Data Grid cell
                - Diagram:
                    - ER diagram palettes and object colors now update immediately after switching themes
                    - Fixed an error when activating an ER diagram with the Content Outline open (thanks to @zsewasdsdsd)
                - Data transfer:
                    - Added configurable XLSX sheet name patterns with `${n}` and `${table}` variables
                    - Canceled data exports now show a cancellation notification instead of a completion message
                - Connectivity:
                    - Added support for more than 200 CData drivers. Users can now start a trial or purchase a license for personal use directly from the connection page
                    - Fixed the "Close idle connections after" setting being lost after saving or restarting DBeaver (thanks to @zsewasdsdsd)
                    - Network profile changes are now saved only after Apply or OK; Cancel discards them
                - Navigator:
                    - Delete actions now identify the selected object type, such as "Delete Connection" or "Delete Table"
                    - Fixed duplicated icons and other artifacts during horizontal scrolling in the Navigator on macOS
                - Security:
                    - Updated the bundled Java runtime to protect TLS connections from certificates affected by the eMudhra CA key compromise
                - Product configuration:
                    - Disabling AI integration now hides AI Chat and prevents saved chat views from reopening as errors
                    - Product Configuration now shows and highlights only newly available features when opened after an update
                - Miscellaneous:
                    - Fixed automatic updates for ZIP-based DBeaver installations on Windows
                    - Fixed Git extension installation and missing Git features in Community Edition
                    - Improved application startup performance
                - New drivers:
                    - Added the Mimer SQL driver with native support for database objects, privileges, and spatial data (thanks to @fredrikalund)
                - Databases:
                    - Apache Hive: Fixed driver library downloads for versions 4.0.0-alpha-1 and 4.0.0-alpha-2
                    - Firebird: Improved table loading and database-to-database export mapping performance by eliminating long domain metadata delays
                    - GBase 8s: Fixed database obj
